subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should this Slack channel discovery request be split into a focused `channel-info`/`channel-list` PR, or continue through the broad Slack action-parity PR?
rationale: The feature is valid and aligned, but the only active implementation path is a broad protected PR with compatibility/security/proof blockers, so automation should not pick a duplicate path without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split Focused Discovery Work
options.body: Land a narrow Slack PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, using the existing `channelInfo` gate unless maintainers intentionally choose a separate list gate.

options.title: Continue Broad Parity PR
options.body: Use the open Slack parity PR as the canonical implementation path after its conflict, proof, security, and scope concerns are resolved.

options.title: Defer Channel Discovery
options.body: Keep the issue open as an accepted feature request until maintainers are ready to revisit Slack action-surface expansion.

recommendation.title: Split Focused Discovery Work
recommendation.body: Land a narrow Slack PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, using the existing `channelInfo` gate unless maintainers intentionally choose a separate list gate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current broad Slack parity candidate and is the recent current-main owner of the Slack action discovery and docs surfaces.
